title: Design: Bill Invoices To window has Cancel before Save
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom.
  • Have customer A (it pays for others) and customer B, with customer A saved as customer B's Bill Invoices To in Edit Customer, so one customer is the other's saved payer.
  • Start on customer B's page.
  • Open the attached picture bt-p1-13-after-change.png at 100% zoom beside the screen.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The window's buttons read "Cancel" (grey) then "Save" (blue).
